title: Yoganandan 1998 ribs 7-8 total cross-sectional area (three-point bending)

source.sample: ribs 7 and 8, left and right (~150 mm segments, posterior axillary line to midclavicular region; up to 4 per subject) from 30 autopsy cadavers (19 M, 11 F)

protocol.summary: Rib segments simply supported over a 100 mm clear span, three-point bending with midspan load at 2.5 mm/min to failure, no rotational constraints; cross-sectional geometry measured after test; E from beam theory.
how_to_simulate: Model a ~150 mm rib 7 or 8 segment simply supported on a 100 mm span
Load at midspan quasi-statically to failure
Report failure force, midspan deflection and back-calculated E

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 from text layer; '+-' dispersion type not stated in table (magnitudes suggest standard error) - stored in 'pm', sd left null. Units converted: cm -> mm (x10), cm2 -> mm2 (x100), cm4 -> mm4 (x1e4); original in 'orig'. n per column not stated (30 subjects, up to 4 ribs each). doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
